prompt: The requirement: no direct pushes to `main` and at least one review — enforced, not requested. One line in the plan fails that requirement. Click it.
explanation: A CONTRIBUTING.md rule is a request — it cannot stop anyone. Only the branch protection rule enforces: requiring reviews and checks makes "no direct pushes, always reviewed" a technical fact.
codeLines: Document the review rule in CONTRIBUTING.md
Enable a branch protection rule on main
Require one approving review before merge
Require status checks to pass before merge
